crossRefs.note: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart…
Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in…
We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

translations.web: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.
translations.bsb: Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.
translations.kjv: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
translations.asv: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
